title: Trust domain codes come from the value set
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.1 Subclaims defined in this guide; Trust Domains; GDHCN Trust Domain value set. QR Code Generation, 2.1 Subclaims defined in this guide: “The registered production trust domains are DDCC, IPS-PILGRIMAGE, PH4H and ICVP.”.

statements.label: Trust domain codes come from the value set
statements.requirement: Trust domain codes (currently DDCC, IPS-PILGRIMAGE, PH4H, ICVP) SHALL be treated as data loaded from, or checked against, the GDHCN Trust Domain value set. They SHALL NOT be a closed enum.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-SEL-006 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-SEL-006 trust domains are read from the GDHCN code system, not a closed list` (TrustListTest.kt)).
